I searched for `PlanId` across the repo (excluding `node_modules`). Along with the definition in `src/types/billing.ts` (`"free" | "starter" | "growth" | "enterprise"`), 14 files under `src/` name the type. No file imports it under a different name or reaches it through a barrel re-export.

- **Types:** `src/types/billing.ts` (the definition, plus `PLAN_IDS: readonly PlanId[]` and `plan: PlanId` fields), `src/types/organization.ts`, `src/types/feature-flag.ts` (`minPlan: PlanId`), and `src/types/event.ts` (`billing.plan_changed` has `from`/`to: PlanId`).
- **Config:** `src/config/plan-limits.ts` has the `PLAN_LIMITS: Record<PlanId, PlanLimits>` key position. It also has `PLAN_ORDER: readonly PlanId[]` and the signatures of the helpers themselves (`getPlanLimits`, `getLimit`, `planAtLeast`, …).
- **Schemas:** `src/schemas/billing.ts` has the `_planParity: PlanId` check against the zod `planIdSchema`, which has to gain the new value too.
- **Server:** `src/server/services/billing-service.ts`, `src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts` and `src/server/db/seed.ts`.
- **Lib:** `src/lib/rate-limit.ts` has `Map<OrgId, PlanId>` as a type argument.
- **UI:** `src/app/(marketing)/_components/pricing-grid.tsx` has the `PLAN_BLURBS: Record<PlanId, string>` key position. `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/billing/page.tsx`, `src/components/domain/billing/plan-comparison-table.tsx`, `src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx` and `src/components/domain/activity/activity-feed.tsx` also name the type.

The two `Record<PlanId, …>` objects (`PLAN_LIMITS` and `PLAN_BLURBS`) and the zod schema are the places that will actually stop compiling until they get the new entry.

I left out test files because the question asks for source files. If you count tests, these six also name the type: `tests/contract/plan-limits.test.ts`, `tests/config/nav.test.ts`, `tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts`, `tests/components/command-groups.test.ts`, `tests/jobs/digest-email-job.test.ts`. The `PlanId` hits in `scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts` and `corpus-manifest.json` are only text inside signature strings, not type references, so I left them out too.

ANSWER: src/types/billing.ts, src/types/feature-flag.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/types/organization.ts, src/config/plan-limits.ts, src/schemas/billing.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/lib/rate-limit.ts, src/app/(marketing)/_components/pricing-grid.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/billing/page.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/plan-comparison-table.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx, src/components/domain/activity/activity-feed.tsx
